import sys

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# COBOL STRINGOPS port – behavioural equivalence only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Fixed field widths (from PIC clauses)
W_FIRST = 10
W_LAST  = 10
W_FULL  = 25
W_PART  = 12          # WS-P1, WS-P2, WS-P3
W_NUM   = 3           # WS-PTR, WS-CNT (PIC 9(3))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers that implement COBOL ACCEPT / DISPLAY semantics
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def cobol_accept(width: int) -> str:
    """Read one line, strip newline, take first `width` chars, pad with spaces."""
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:                     # EOF -> empty line
        line = ""
    else:
        line = line.rstrip('\n')     # keep other whitespace
    # Truncate on the right (rule 3b), then pad to fixed width
    return (line[:width]).ljust(width)


def disp_num(value: int, width: int) -> str:
    """PIC 9(n) – zero-padded, no sign."""
    return str(value % (10 ** width)).zfill(width)


def disp_alpha(value: str, width: int) -> str:
    """PIC X(n) – left-justified, space-padded / truncated."""
    return value[:width].ljust(width)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Main paragraph
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def main_para() -> None:
    # ----- WORKING-STORAGE initial values -----
    ws_first = " " * W_FIRST
    ws_last  = " " * W_LAST
    ws_full  = "-" * W_FULL
    ws_ptr   = 1                     # 1-based pointer
    ws_p1    = "PREV1".ljust(W_PART)
    ws_p2    = "PREV2".ljust(W_PART)
    ws_p3    = "PREV3".ljust(W_PART)
    ws_cnt   = 0

    # ----- ACCEPT WS-FIRST / WS-LAST -----
    ws_first = cobol_accept(W_FIRST)
    ws_last  = cobol_accept(W_LAST)

    # ----- MOVE 1 TO WS-PTR -----
    ws_ptr = 1

    # ----- STRING ... INTO WS-FULL WITH POINTER WS-PTR -----
    # Part 1: WS-FIRST DELIMITED BY SPACE
    sp = ws_first.find(' ')
    part1 = ws_first if sp == -1 else ws_first[:sp]

    # Part 2: "," DELIMITED BY SIZE  (literal comma, size 1)
    part2 = ","

    # Part 3: WS-LAST DELIMITED BY SPACE
    sp = ws_last.find(' ')
    part3 = ws_last if sp == -1 else ws_last[:sp]

    combined = part1 + part2 + part3

    # Write into WS-FULL starting at WS-PTR (1-based)
    start = ws_ptr - 1                       # 0-based index
    available = W_FULL - start
    if available < 0:
        available = 0
    to_write = combined[:available]

    # Mutate ws_full (strings are immutable → list)
    full_list = list(ws_full)
    for i, ch in enumerate(to_write):
        full_list[start + i] = ch
    ws_full = "".join(full_list)

    # Pointer ends at next unused position (1-based)
    ws_ptr = start + len(to_write) + 1

    # ----- DISPLAY "FULL  [" WS-FULL "]" -----
    sys.stdout.write("FULL  [" + disp_alpha(ws_full, W_FULL) + "]\n")

    # ----- DISPLAY "PTR    " WS-PTR -----
    sys.stdout.write("PTR    " + disp_num(ws_ptr, W_NUM) + "\n")

    # ----- UNSTRING WS-FULL DELIMITED BY "," INTO WS-P1 WS-P2 WS-P3 TALLYING IN WS-CNT -----
    source = ws_full
    targets = [ws_p1, ws_p2, ws_p3]
    substrings = []
    idx = 0
    # Scan source for commas, collect up to 3 substrings
    for i, ch in enumerate(source):
        if ch == ',':
            substrings.append(source[idx:i])
            idx = i + 1
            if len(substrings) == 3:
                break
    else:
        # No break → add final substring if we still have room
        if len(substrings) < 3:
            substrings.append(source[idx:])

    # Move substrings into targets (left-justified, space-padded/truncated)
    filled = 0
    new_targets = []
    for i in range(3):
        if i < len(substrings):
            sub = substrings[i]
            new_targets.append(disp_alpha(sub, W_PART))
            filled += 1
        else:
            new_targets.append(targets[i])   # untouched → keep previous value
    ws_p1, ws_p2, ws_p3 = new_targets
    ws_cnt = filled

    # ----- DISPLAY P1, P2, P3, CNT -----
    sys.stdout.write("P1    [" + disp_alpha(ws_p1, W_PART) + "]\n")
    sys.stdout.write("P2    [" + disp_alpha(ws_p2, W_PART) + "]\n")
    sys.stdout.write("P3    [" + disp_alpha(ws_p3, W_PART) + "]\n")
    sys.stdout.write("CNT    " + disp_num(ws_cnt, W_NUM) + "\n")

    # STOP RUN → implicit return


# ------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main_para()

*> STRING and UNSTRING with an explicit POINTER.
      *> Gotcha 1: DELIMITED BY SPACE stops at the first space, so the
      *>           PIC X(10) padding is dropped - but DELIMITED BY SIZE
      *>           copies the whole field including padding.
      *> Gotcha 2: WITH POINTER is 1-based and is left pointing at the next
      *>           unused position AFTER the statement, not at the last
      *>           character written.
      *> Gotcha 3: UNSTRING TALLYING counts receiving fields FILLED, and
      *>           untouched receiving fields keep their previous contents
      *>           rather than being cleared.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. STRINGOPS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FIRST            PIC X(10)    VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-LAST             PIC X(10)    VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-FULL             PIC X(25)    VALUE ALL "-".
       01  WS-PTR              PIC 9(3)     VALUE 1.
       01  WS-P1               PIC X(12)    VALUE "PREV1".
       01  WS-P2               PIC X(12)    VALUE "PREV2".
       01  WS-P3               PIC X(12)    VALUE "PREV3".
       01  WS-CNT              PIC 9(3)     VALUE ZERO.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           ACCEPT WS-FIRST
           ACCEPT WS-LAST
           MOVE 1 TO WS-PTR
           STRING WS-FIRST DELIMITED BY SPACE
                  "," DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  WS-LAST DELIMITED BY SPACE
               INTO WS-FULL
               WITH POINTER WS-PTR
           END-STRING
           DISPLAY "FULL  [" WS-FULL "]"
           DISPLAY "PTR    " WS-PTR
           UNSTRING WS-FULL
               DELIMITED BY ","
               INTO WS-P1 WS-P2 WS-P3
               TALLYING IN WS-CNT
           END-UNSTRING
           DISPLAY "P1    [" WS-P1 "]"
           DISPLAY "P2    [" WS-P2 "]"
           DISPLAY "P3    [" WS-P3 "]"
           DISPLAY "CNT    " WS-CNT
           STOP RUN.
